responsibility: Implements a GIMPLE loop-versioning pass focused on stride==1 specialization. It analyzes address expressions to find loop-invariant stride terms that likely index inner array dimensions, prunes impossible cases with ranger-derived range information, applies a loop-size and profitability model, versions selected loops with a runtime condition that checks candidate strides for unity, and then simplifies the optimized clone under the assumed condition to aid vectorization and later loop optimizations.
